plugins.name: tuanjie
plugins.description: Tuanjie Engine (团结引擎) game-development skills for coding agents — adapted from Unity's official agent plugin with Tuanjie-specific tooling, WeChat Mini Game awareness, and China-market guidance.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 团结引擎游戏开发技能包（ZCode 版）。基于 Unity 官方 agent 插件移植并针对团结引擎改造：Tuanjie 编辑器命令行自动化、packages.unity.cn 包管理、微信小游戏与国内渠道指引，内含 27 个覆盖 UI、2D/Tilemap、导航、物理、URP 渲染、音频、内购与本地化的技能。
description_i18n.en-US: Tuanjie Engine game-development skills for ZCode — ported from Unity's official agent plugin with Tuanjie-specific tooling: editor binary automation, packages.unity.cn registry, WeChat Mini Game and China-market guidance, covering UI, 2D/Tilemap, navigation, physics, URP, audio, IAP, and localization.

examplePrompts: 为我的团结引擎 2D 游戏搭建带规则瓦片（RuleTile）的关卡。
把一个 Unity 2022 项目迁移到团结引擎，处理包管理器报错。
帮我的团结引擎项目接入内购，目标渠道是微信小游戏和苹果商店。
Set up a tilemap level with rule tiles in my Tuanjie 2D game.
Migrate a Unity 2022 project to Tuanjie Engine and fix package resolution.
